quality_short.why: body under 400 chars — the too_short gate

quality_no_body.why: no body at all — the extractor's own failure mode

russia_dense.why: 3+ Russia/Ukraine terms — the axis that is 94% not_applicable in the current corpus

entity_rich.why: 3+ gazetteer-resolved mentions — measures the mention layer's precision, which matters more than its recall

person_linked.why: at least one resolvable PERSON — the highest-consequence link the site renders

no_author.why: no byline — one of the AI-generation signals

mainstream.why: everything else, so the ordinary case is measured too

drawn_for_is_not_a_label: each article records the CELL IT WAS DRAWN FOR, never a judgment. „russia_dense" means the word Русия occurs three times; it does not mean the article is pro-Russian, and a scorer treating it as a label would be measuring this file's regex rather than a model.
